author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Send personalized emails to hundreds of people directly from Gmail using a 100% free mail merge add-on.

In this step-by-step tutorial, I'll show you how to install my free Gmail Mail Merge add-on, connect it to a Google Sheets spreadsheet, personalize emails with merge fields, add custom subject lines, include PDF attachments, use CC and BCC recipients, preview your emails before sending, and send your mail merge in just a few clicks.

Whether you're sending invoices, newsletters, customer updates, event invitations, or sales emails, this tutorial will help you get started quickly.

Host: Kevin Stratvert
